verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.restored: Speak to all congregation of children of Israel and say to them: Holy you shall be, for I, YHWH your Divine, am holy.

familiar.text: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God am holy.

verses.restored: Each one shall revere mother and father, and my Sabbaths you shall keep. I am YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.

verses.restored: Do not turn to idols, and molten gods you shall not make for yourselves. I am YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the LORD your God.

verses.restored: When you sacrifice sacrifice of peace/well-being to YHWH, you shall sacrifice it for your acceptance.

familiar.text: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.

verses.restored: On day of your sacrificing it shall be eaten and on next day; what remains until third day shall be burned in fire.

familiar.text: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.

verses.restored: If eating, it is eaten on third day, it is offensive; it shall not be accepted.

familiar.text: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.

verses.restored: The one eating it shall bear iniquity, because holy thing of YHWH he profaned; that soul/life shall be cut off from its people.

familiar.text: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.restored: When you reap harvest of your land, you shall not reap to edge of your field, and gleaning of your harvest you shall not gather.

familiar.text: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.

verses.restored: Your vineyard you shall not strip, and fallen grapes of your vineyard you shall not gather; for poor and for sojourner you shall leave them. I am YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the LORD your God.

verses.restored: You shall not steal, and you shall not deceive, and you shall not lie, each to one's companion.

familiar.text: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

verses.restored: You shall not swear by my name falsely and profane name of your Divine. I am YHWH.

familiar.text: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.

verses.restored: You shall not oppress your companion and shall not rob; wages of hired worker shall not remain with you until morning.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

verses.restored: You shall not curse deaf one, and before blind one you shall not put stumbling block; you shall fear your Divine. I am YHWH.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.

verses.restored: You shall do no injustice in judgment; you shall not lift face of poor one and shall not honor face of great one; in righteousness/justice you shall judge your companion.

familiar.text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

verses.restored: You shall not go about as slanderer among your people; you shall not stand upon blood/life of your companion. I am YHWH.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.

verses.restored: You shall not hate your brother in your heart; rebuking, you shall rebuke your companion, and not bear sin/misalignment because of him.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

verses.restored: You shall not take vengeance and shall not keep grudge against sons of your people; you shall love your neighbor/companion as yourself. I am YHWH.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.

verses.restored: My statutes you shall keep. Your beast you shall not breed mixed kinds; your field you shall not sow mixed seed; garment of mixed kinds, mixed material, shall not come upon you.

familiar.text: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.

familiar.text: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

verses.restored: He shall bring his guilt/reparation offering to YHWH, to entrance of tent of meeting, ram of guilt/reparation offering.

familiar.text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.

verses.restored: Priest shall make atonement/covering for him with ram of guilt/reparation before YHWH for his sin/misalignment that he sinned, and it shall be forgiven him from his sin/misalignment that he sinned.

familiar.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.

verses.restored: When you come into land and plant any tree for food, you shall regard its fruit as foreskin/uncircumcised; three years it shall be uncircumcised to you, not eaten.

familiar.text: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.

verses.restored: In fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, praise-offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD withal.

verses.restored: In fifth year you may eat its fruit, so it may add its produce to you. I am YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the LORD your God.

verses.restored: You shall not eat upon blood/life. You shall not practice divination, nor interpret omens.

familiar.text: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.

verses.restored: You shall not round off edge of your head, and you shall not destroy edge of your beard.

familiar.text: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

verses.restored: Cuttings for the dead you shall not put in your flesh, and tattoo/mark writing you shall not put on yourselves. I am YHWH.

familiar.text: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD.

verses.restored: Do not profane your daughter by making her a prostitute, lest land prostitute itself and land be filled with wickedness.

familiar.text: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

verses.restored: My Sabbaths you shall keep, and my sanctuary you shall revere. I am YHWH.

familiar.text: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.

verses.restored: Do not turn to ghosts/mediums, and to familiar spirits do not seek, becoming unclean by them. I am YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.

verses.restored: Before gray hair you shall rise, and honor face of old one; you shall fear your Divine. I am YHWH.

familiar.text: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.

verses.restored: When sojourner sojourns with you in your land, you shall not wrong him.

familiar.text: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.

verses.restored: As native among you shall sojourner be to you, the one sojourning with you; you shall love him as yourself, for you were sojourners in land of Egypt. I am YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

verses.restored: You shall do no injustice in judgment, in measure, weight, or quantity.

familiar.text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.

verses.restored: Just balances, just weights, just ephah, and just hin you shall have. I am YHWH your Divine, who brought you out from land of Egypt.

familiar.text: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.

verses.restored: You shall keep all my statutes and all my judgments, and do them. I am YHWH.

familiar.text: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the LORD.

translation_notes: Leviticus 19 is a central holiness/social ethics chapter: holiness includes field margins, wages, disability justice, truthful speech, courts, elders, sojourners, and honest measures.
Love your neighbor/companion as yourself in v.18 and love the sojourner as yourself in v.34 must be held together.
Verse 20 involves an enslaved/unfree woman and requires sexual-exploitation and consent audit; do not normalize enslavement or coercive sex.
Do not curse the deaf or put stumbling block before blind person is disability justice, not metaphor only.
Honest weights are grounded in Exodus liberation memory.
safety_note: Leviticus 19 must not be reduced to ritual oddities. It is one of the strongest justice chapters in Torah: leave food for poor and sojourner, pay wages promptly, protect disabled people, refuse slander, love neighbor and sojourner, and use honest measures.
